title: Building Anthropic | A conversation with our co-founders
description: The co-founders of Anthropic discuss the past, present, and future of Anthropic. From left to right: Chris Olah, Jack Clark, Daniela Amodei, Sam McCandlish, Tom Brown, Dario Amodei, and Jared Kaplan.
